teaches: The layering masterclass of this wave: 18+ scene layers build one bed holding THREE characters — Nicole, Gumball (middle) and Richard — all tucked under a single dark duvet while a bedtime story is read. Each character gets duvet-side and duvet MASK layers so bodies sink under the blanket correctly, Gumball gets his own duvet piece, and 'DAD OVERLAY HANDS' rides on top so hands rest on the covers. The performances are tiny (mouths, eyelids, one eye popping open) — the construction is the show.
notes: Three heads, one blanket: Nicole left, Gumball centre, Richard right. Gumball's one-eye-open beat (around frames 62-93) is the gag — he's faking sleep during the story.
Masks, not redraws, solve occlusion: DUVET MOM MASK / DUVET DAD MASK clip each body to its place under the shared duvet.
Costume-variant puppets again: GB211_PYJAMAS_DAD_PUPPET and GB211_PYJAMAS_MOM_PUPPET — pyjama versions of the stock puppets, built for this episode.
'DAD ANIMATION copy' (452 kf) and 'MOM ANIMATION copy' (370 kf): scene-specific copies are edited in place; library originals stay clean.
In the production SWF export the bedroom background renders white — the visible architecture is the duvet sandwich itself; frame-counter and field-guide overlays are part of the export.
